titlePlain: UI Policy vs. Data Policy: When to Use
subtitle: Lesson 22 · UI Policies, Data Policies & Business Rules (Admin View)

code:
Must this rule hold true...
  ...only on the rendered form?     -> UI Policy
  ...no matter how the record       -> Data Policy
     is written (form/API/import)?
caption: Form experience vs. data integrity — one question, one answer.

steps.label: Hide clutter
steps.sub: irrelevant field, no consequence if bypassed -> UI Policy

steps.label: Enforce always
steps.sub: must hold true even via API -> Data Policy

code:
Data integrity at stake?  -> default to Data Policy
  (Apply to UI still gives live form feedback)

Need Visible / hidden?    -> must use a UI Policy
  (Data Policies never control visibility)
caption: Many real rules end up using both tools together.

subtitle: A far more powerful — and riskier — mechanism.
